# Jesus Says

> Jesus Says: Daily Reflection is an iPhone and iPad app for daily Scripture reflection and prayer. jesussays.app is its official website and publishes a small library of Scripture-based guides.

Key facts:
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/jesus-says-daily-reflection/id6756906208
- Platforms: iPhone and iPad (no Android version).
- Price: free to download with 7 days of full access; Plus Monthly and Plus Annual subscriptions continue it.
- Daily practice: one verse, one reflection, one prayer, and one step for today ("Today with God").
- Speak or type a private reflection and receive Scripture, a short reflection, and a prayer.
- Also: a 7-day path through Scripture, Be Still quiet moments (Still Waters, Peace Be Still, Consider the Heavens), Listen Mode read-aloud, a private Verse Library and journal, and the full King James Bible.
- Responses are generated from Scripture and are not reviewed by religious authorities. The app is not a replacement for church, pastoral care, counseling, medical care, or emergency services.
- Website Scripture quotations use the King James Version (public domain), matching the app's Bible reader.
- Contact: hello@jesussays.app

## App
- [Jesus Says on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/jesus-says-daily-reflection/id6756906208): download page for iPhone and iPad
- [About the app](https://jesussays.app/download.html): features, screenshots, and pricing
- [Still Waters](https://jesussays.app/play/still-waters/): a free, quiet ink-on-water moment from the app that runs in the browser
- [About Jesus Says](https://jesussays.app/about.html): who publishes the site and its editorial standards

## Faith Library

### Anxiety, fear & peace
- [Bible Verses for Anxiety and Worry](https://jesussays.app/content/bible-verses-anxiety.html): The Bible's clearest verses for anxiety, Philippians 4:6-7 and 1 Peter 5:7, plus whether anxiety is a sin and how to pray Scripture when worry won't stop.
- [What Would Jesus Say About Fear?](https://jesussays.app/content/what-would-jesus-say-about-fear.html): What Jesus actually said to frightened people in the Gospels, “Be not afraid,” in its context, whether he is disappointed by our fear, and how to hear it today.
- [Bible Verses About Peace When You're Afraid](https://jesussays.app/content/bible-verses-about-peace-and-fear.html): KJV Bible verses about peace for when fear takes hold: Psalm 56:3, Isaiah 26:3, John 14:27, and how to find God's peace when fear hits.
- [Night Prayer for Sleep and Anxiety](https://jesussays.app/content/night-prayer-for-sleep-and-anxiety.html): A short night prayer for when anxiety keeps you awake, drawn from Psalm 4:8 and Psalm 31:5, plus Bible verses for sleep and what to pray when you can't rest.
- [Christian Advice for Anxiety at Work and Burnout](https://jesussays.app/content/christian-advice-for-anxiety-at-work.html): Christian advice for work stress and burnout: where your worth comes from (Colossians 3:23-24), short prayers for the workday, and why setting limits is biblical.
- [Bible Verses for Anxiety About Money](https://jesussays.app/content/bible-verses-for-anxiety-about-money.html): Bible verses for money worries, from Matthew 6:31-33 to Hebrews 13:5, with honest help for praying about bills and why trusting God still includes planning.

### Grief, depression & hard seasons
- [A Prayer for Depression and Hopelessness](https://jesussays.app/content/prayer-for-depression-and-hopelessness.html): A gentle prayer for depression and hopelessness, how to pray when you're too tired to pray, and why seeking help is part of faith, not a failure of it.
- [Bible Verses for Depression](https://jesussays.app/content/bible-verses-for-depression.html): KJV Bible verses for depression, from Psalm 34:18 to Romans 8:38-39, why Psalm 88 is in the Bible, and why depression is not a sign of weak faith.
- [Grief and Loss: Questions Christians Ask](https://jesussays.app/content/questions-christians-ask-about-loss.html): Honest, Scripture-based answers for grief: is it wrong for a Christian to grieve, why God let this happen, how to pray through loss, and how to help others.
- [Bible Verses for Loneliness and Isolation](https://jesussays.app/content/bible-verses-for-loneliness-and-isolation.html): Bible verses for loneliness, including Psalm 139:7-10 and Isaiah 49:15-16, on God's nearness and his gift of people, plus how to pray when you feel alone.
- [Bible Verses for Strength in Hard Times](https://jesussays.app/content/bible-verses-for-strength-hard-times.html): Bible verses for strength when you're worn out: Isaiah 40:29-31, 2 Corinthians 12:9, Psalm 73:26, and what Philippians 4:13 really means in a hard season.
- [Bible Verses for Job Loss and Unemployment](https://jesussays.app/content/bible-verses-for-job-loss-and-unemployment.html): Bible verses for job loss that promise God's care, not a quick fix: Matthew 6:32, Philippians 4:6-7, and help praying through a job search when you feel forgotten.

### Healing & hope
- [A Prayer for Healing](https://jesussays.app/content/prayer-for-healing.html): A prayer for healing for yourself or someone you love, grounded in James 5:14-15, with a daily prayer rhythm and honest help for when healing doesn't come.
- [Bible Verses for Healing](https://jesussays.app/content/bible-verses-for-healing.html): Comforting Bible verses for healing, like Jeremiah 17:14 and Psalm 147:3, with honest answers on whether God heals every sickness and seeing a doctor.
- [A Short Prayer for Hope](https://jesussays.app/content/short-prayer-for-hope.html): A one-minute prayer for hope, short prayers for hard moments, what the Bible means by hope, and what to do when you pray for hope and still feel hopeless.

### Prayer & daily devotion
- [How to Pray According to the Bible](https://jesussays.app/content/how-to-pray-according-to-the-bible.html): How to pray according to the Bible, with the Lord’s Prayer in Matthew 6 as a model, KJV verses, simple habits, a short prayer, and answers to common questions.
- [Daily Devotional for Today](https://jesussays.app/content/daily-devotional-today.html): A five-minute daily devotional for today: one KJV passage from Lamentations 3, a short reflection, a written prayer, one step, and a week of readings.
- [Morning Prayer for Protection](https://jesussays.app/content/morning-prayer-for-protection.html): A morning prayer for protection with KJV verses from Psalm 121, Psalm 91, and Ephesians 6, what Psalm 91 does and doesn’t promise, and steps for each day.
- [A 7-Day Devotional for New Believers](https://jesussays.app/content/7-day-devotional-for-new-faith.html): A simple 7-day devotional for new believers and new Christians: one Bible passage, a short reflection, and a prayer or next step for each day of the week.

### Faith, doubt & the words of Jesus
- [Bible Verses About Faith and Trust in God](https://jesussays.app/content/bible-verses-about-faith-and-trust.html): KJV Bible verses about faith and trust in God, what they mean, and practical ways to keep trusting God when you feel afraid or out of control.
- [Doubting God? Christian Advice for Seasons of Doubt](https://jesussays.app/content/christian-advice-for-doubt.html): Is it a sin to doubt God? What the Bible says about doubt, how Jesus treated doubters like Thomas and Peter, and practical steps and a prayer for doubt.
- [What Would Jesus Say About Your Purpose?](https://jesussays.app/content/what-would-jesus-say-about-purpose.html): Jesus' words on purpose and calling, starting with “Follow me,” whether God has a specific plan for your life, and how to find your purpose as a Christian.
- [Jesus Quotes on Love, Mercy, and Truth](https://jesussays.app/content/jesus-quotes-on-love-mercy-and-truth.html): Jesus' own words on love, mercy, and truth from the Gospels in the KJV, with short context for each and how the three belong together in his teaching.

### Confession, temptation & forgiveness
- [Confession Prayer Guide: Praying Psalm 51](https://jesussays.app/content/confession-prayer-guide.html): How to pray a confession prayer with Psalm 51: KJV verses, simple steps, a written prayer, confession before fasting, and notes for Catholic and Protestant readers.
- [A Confession Prayer After Failure](https://jesussays.app/content/confession-prayer-after-failure.html): A confession prayer after failure: the difference between guilt and shame, Psalm 32, 1 John 1:9, how Jesus restored Peter in John 21, and steps to begin again.
- [A Confession Prayer for Addiction Recovery](https://jesussays.app/content/confession-prayer-for-addiction-recovery.html): A confession prayer for addiction recovery, with KJV verses, simple steps, help after a relapse, and where to find support, including the SAMHSA helpline.
- [Bible Verses and a Prayer for Temptation](https://jesussays.app/content/bible-verses-and-prayer-for-temptation.html): Bible verses for temptation, including 1 Corinthians 10:13 and how Jesus resisted in the wilderness, plus a prayer for when temptation hits right now.
- [A Daily Devotional on Forgiveness When the Hurt Is Still Raw](https://jesussays.app/content/daily-devotional-on-forgiveness.html): A devotional for forgiving someone who hurt you when the pain is fresh: KJV readings, honest steps for today, a prayer, and when reconciliation isn't safe.
- [What the Bible Says About Love and Forgiveness](https://jesussays.app/content/love-and-forgiveness.html): What the Bible teaches about love and forgiveness: 1 Corinthians 13, seventy times seven, Ephesians 4:32, and loving enemies in Luke 6, in the KJV.

### Relationships & character
- [Christian Advice for Relationships](https://jesussays.app/content/christian-advice-for-relationships.html): Biblical advice for relationships: KJV verses on listening and speech, Christian dating, handling conflict, healthy boundaries, and praying over a relationship.
- [A Prayer for Family and Marriage](https://jesussays.app/content/prayer-for-family-and-marriage.html): A written prayer for your family and marriage, KJV verses to pray, simple steps for praying for a spouse or children, and what to do if home isn't safe.
- [Is Anger a Sin? What the Bible Says About Anger](https://jesussays.app/content/questions-christians-ask-about-anger.html): Is anger a sin? Ephesians 4:26, James 1:19-20, and Jesus in the temple show when anger is right, when it becomes sin, and how to handle it without harm.
- [Bible Verses and a Prayer for Patience](https://jesussays.app/content/bible-verses-and-prayer-for-patience.html): What the Bible says about patience while you wait on God and with difficult people, with KJV verses like Psalm 37:7 and a simple prayer for patience.

### Compare Christian apps
- [Best Christian Prayer Apps in 2026: An Honest Comparison](https://jesussays.app/content/best-christian-prayer-apps.html): Hallow, Glorify, YouVersion, and Jesus Says compared honestly: who each Christian prayer app suits, what it costs, and where each is the better choice.
- [Jesus Says vs Hallow: Which Prayer App Fits You?](https://jesussays.app/content/jesus-says-vs-hallow.html): An honest comparison of Jesus Says and Hallow: audio-guided Catholic prayer versus a short daily Scripture reflection, with features, cost, and devices.
- [Jesus Says vs Glorify: Which Devotional App Fits You?](https://jesussays.app/content/jesus-says-vs-glorify.html): Jesus Says and Glorify compared honestly: a guided devotional routine with worship music versus a short daily Scripture reflection and prayer app.
- [Jesus Says vs YouVersion Bible App: An Honest Comparison](https://jesussays.app/content/jesus-says-vs-youversion.html): YouVersion's free Bible App and Jesus Says compared: Bible versions, reading plans, prayer, community, cost, and when each app is the better choice.
